_comment: Corrections applied by scripts/update_module_catalog.py on top of the modulefile .yaml metadata.
Use this when a .yaml file has wrong metadata that cannot be fixed right away.
Keys: cluster -> module -> any of description, url, tags (list). Given fields replace the .yaml values.
The script reports overrides that are no longer needed once the .yaml has been fixed; remove them then.
